verdict.rationale: Claude's own docs say users can connect Claude to existing remote MCP servers as custom connectors, and can install local MCP servers on Claude Desktop 'as easily as browser extensions'. A unified directory lets users find and install connectors. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that plugged-in MCP tools work in practice.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Connect Claude to existing remote MCP servers.
Integrate any context or tool through connectors with remote MCP
you can now install local MCP servers on your computer as easily as browser extensions
Our unified directory brings skills, connectors, and plugins together in one place so you can find and install everything that customizes Claude
